overview_description.description: RocketSDR provides an AI-native sales development platform that functions as an autonomous sales development representative for B2B teams. The platform automates outbound pipeline generation by handling prospecting, lead enrichment, and multichannel outreach across email and social channels. It layers artificial intelligence over a real-time prospect database and signal intelligence engine that tracks hiring changes, funding rounds, job moves, and website activity. RocketSDR researches each prospect across multiple public data sources before composing personalized messages that reference current, relevant context. The system also manages email infrastructure, including warmup, deliverability monitoring, and mailbox rotation, so campaigns reach inboxes rather than spam. Integrations with common CRM, email, and collaboration tools allow data to sync in both directions. RocketSDR is designed for sales and go-to-market teams that want to run outbound as a continuous, learning experiment rather than a static set of sequences.
